heading: Search your knowledge
intro: Search projects, facts, preferences, experience and history. Follow each result to its evidence.
empty: No matches. Try another query or clear filters.
empty_library: No published knowledge yet. Organizing adds supported records.
date_hint: Date filters omit records whose date is unknown; legacy dates are never invented.
missing_sources: {count} recorded source references have no available metadata.
empty_sources: No original sources were recorded for this item.
quote: Quoted evidence from the saved record
historical_state: Historical project state · Earlier context preserved
method_review: Method inference · Compared with candidate summaries
project_context_note: Legacy sources describe broader project context; direct evidence and event time are unavailable.
session_context_note: Sources belong to the discussion of this record; the date is the session time.
summary_context_note: Based on saved summaries, not independent verification of raw evidence. Inspect original sources for detail and scope.
source_page: Showing {shown} of {total} characters; sensitive patterns are redacted.
error_not_found: This record or source is no longer available. It may have changed after organizing.
error_unavailable: Knowledge is temporarily unavailable. Try again.
error_invalid_search: Check the query and filters, including the date range.
error_invalid_source_request: The requested source page is not valid.
error_source_missing: Original source is missing or has moved.
error_source_changed: Original source changed; its content could not be verified.
error_source_denied: Original source is outside the permitted source folders.
error_source_unverified: The original has no complete, verifiable source metadata.
error_unsupported_source_format: This original format is not supported yet.
error_source_encoding: The original is not supported UTF-8 text.
error_source_too_large: The original exceeds the supported size limit.
